8776907f05d885e069149847589b31708c5fc1f5.summary: A Malpedia family page for HelloKitty, a ransomware family that the page says first surfaced at the end of 2020 and was primarily targeting Windows systems. Its name comes from a mutex called HelloKitty Mutex, and different versions use the .crypted or .kitty file extensions. Newer samples use a Golang packer so the final ransomware code is loaded only in memory. The page says this is most likely to evade security detection. The rest of the page is a dated list of reports from 2020 to 2022 by vendors and agencies, including an FBI report that names FiveHands. The page gives no sectors,…
